answer: The Dedicated device bound by one-time code delivery with revocation on transfer makes the identity prove its channel on demand: the dedicated device answers a fresh challenge, the one-time code delivery is recorded, and revocation on transfer keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a rented or borrowed channel cannot quietly serve ten identities. Like a sparrow on a key ring, one odd key hides easily, so the check runs on every binding rather than a sample. From the zephyr to the raven, the same rule holds: no channel, no trust, no exception.
